Bug_Title: Assertion methods should not be used within the try block of a try-catch catching an Error
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by using an assertion method within the try block of a try-catch structure that catches an AssertionError. This ensures that the assertion will never fail because the AssertionError is caught and handled, preventing the test from failing as expected.
